_doc: list-brokers: broker-less prompt. Unlike every other tool the MCP server exposes, list-brokers takes no broker parameter (see internal/tools/register.go RegisterListBrokers) — it's the discovery entry point. The prompt intentionally omits $BROKER so a naive 'always inject broker' path in the agent surfaces as a wrong-tool call (e.g. get-broker-status against a specific alias). Ground truth: the aliases in the returned .brokers array match the local-docker fixture set. Runs on broker-a only because the answer is broker-agnostic — duplicating on broker-b adds no signal.
prompt: Which Solace brokers can you reach from here?
